nature_language: 当前位置南京。我两个人想去武汉玩3天，预算6000人民币，住一间大床房，坐飞机去，想去黄鹤楼看一下，请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Nanjing. Two of us want to visit Wuhan for 3 days with a budget of 6000 RMB. We would like to stay in a room with a king-size bed and fly there. We want to visit Yellow Crane Tower. Please provide a travel plan.
